mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM sys_role a LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON a.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE a.role_status = 0 AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT a.role_id FROM sys_role a LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON a.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE a.role_status = 0 AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT a.role_id FROM sys_role a WHERE a.role_status = 0 AND a.role_creator = #{userId}
SELECT min( role_id ) AS roleType FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( r.role_name ) AS roleNames FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.role_status = 0 AND u.user_id = #{userId}
